mapper.select: SELECT l.*, m.nickname AS member_nickname, ol.level_name AS old_level_name, nl.level_name AS new_level_name, op.nickname AS operator_name FROM member_level_change_log l JOIN member m ON m.member_id = l.member_id LEFT JOIN member_level ol ON ol.level_id = l.old_level_id JOIN member_level nl ON nl.level_id = l.new_level_id LEFT JOIN member op ON op.member_id = l.operator_id WHERE l.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.change_id DESC

SELECT l.*, m.nickname AS member_nickname, ol.level_name AS old_level_name, nl.level_name AS new_level_name, op.nickname AS operator_name FROM member_level_change_log l JOIN member m ON m.member_id = l.member_id LEFT JOIN member_level ol ON ol.level_id = l.old_level_id JOIN member_level nl ON nl.level_id = l.new_level_id LEFT JOIN member op ON op.member_id = l.operator_id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.change_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
